quote: BROADCASTING ACT (CHAPTER 28, SECTION 66)
gloss: The 2004 Revised Edition of Rg 1 names section 66 of the Broadcasting Act as the section it is made under.

quote: In exercise of the powers conferred by section 66 of the Broadcasting Act
gloss: The 2004 amending regulations say they are made under section 66 of the Broadcasting Act, which lets the Authority, with the Minister's approval, make regulations.

quote: In exercise of the powers conferred by section 66 of the Broadcasting Act
gloss: The 2012 revocation regulations say they are made under section 66 of the Broadcasting Act.

quote: In exercise of the powers conferred by section 65 of the Broadcasting Act
gloss: The 2012 notification says it is made under section 65 of the Broadcasting Act, which lets the Minister amend the First, Second or Third Schedule by notification in the Gazette.

quote: Broadcasting Act (CHAPTER 28, Section 66) Broadcasting (TVRO System) Regulations
gloss: The 2004 Revised Edition of the TVRO regulations names section 66 of the Broadcasting Act as the section they are made under.

quote: In exercise of the powers conferred by section 130 of the Telecommunication Authority of Singapore Act
gloss: The 1998 Order says it is made under section 130 of the Telecommunication Authority of Singapore Act, an Act whose text is not deposited.

quote: TELECOMMUNICATION AUTHORITY OF SINGAPORE ACT (CHAPTER 323, SECTION 131)
gloss: The 1999 Revised Edition of the Dealers Regulations (Rg 7) names section 131 of the Telecommunication Authority of Singapore Act as the section they are made under.

quote: Regulation 2 of the Broadcasting (Television and Radio Licensing) Regulations (Rg 1, 2004 Ed.)
gloss: Deletes the definitions of broadcast sound receiver, broadcast television receiver and TVRO system from regulation 2 of Rg 1, inserts definitions of broadcasting apparatus, commercial property, hospital and licence, and deletes its paragraph (2).

quote: Regulation 7 of the principal Regulations is amended by deleting the words
gloss: Deletes the words 'or of regulation 17, 27 or 36' from regulation 7 of Rg 1.

quote: Regulation 23 of the principal Regulations is amended
gloss: Rewrites paragraphs (1) and (2) of regulation 23 of Rg 1 and deletes some words from its paragraph (5).

quote: Regulation 27 of the principal Regulations is amended
gloss: Rewrites paragraphs (1) and (2) of regulation 27 of Rg 1 and replaces the words 'used by' in its paragraph (4).

quote: Regulation 28 of the principal Regulations is amended
gloss: Rewrites paragraph (1) of regulation 28 of Rg 1 and deletes some words from its paragraph (5).

quote: The principal Regulations are amended by inserting, immediately after regulation 29, the following regulation
gloss: Inserts a new regulation 29A in Rg 1, headed 'Broadcast television receivers in commercial properties'.

quote: Section 72 of the Telecommunications Act is amended by deleting the words
gloss: Replaces the words 'Singapore Broadcasting Authority Act (Cap. 297)' with 'Broadcasting Act (Cap. 28)' in what was then section 72 of the Telecommunications Act.

quote: Section 65 of the Telecommunications Act is amended by inserting, immediately after the words
gloss: Adds words about a further fine for each day a matter continues after conviction to what was then section 65, headed General penalties.

quote: Section 2 of the Telecommunications Act is amended — (a) by inserting, immediately after the definition of “Authority”, the following definition
gloss: Inserts into section 2 of the Telecommunications Act a definition giving broadcasting apparatus and broadcasting service the meanings they have in the Broadcasting Act.

quote: Regulations (Rg 1) (referred to in these Regulations as the revoked Regulations) are revoked
gloss: Revokes Rg 1 with effect deemed to be 1 January 2011, although first published on 31 October 2012.

quote: The Telecommunication (Dealers) Regulations (Rg 7) are revoked
gloss: The 2003 dealers regulations revoke the earlier Telecommunication (Dealers) Regulations (Rg 7).

quote: The First Schedule to the Broadcasting Act is deleted and the following Schedule substituted therefor
gloss: Deletes the First Schedule to the Broadcasting Act and substitutes a Schedule with one item, the TVRO system, with effect deemed to be 1 January 2011 although first published on 31 October 2012.

quote: the revoked Regulations shall continue to apply to and in relation to
gloss: Keeps the revoked regulations applying to licences granted under section 20(1) for any period before 1 January 2011, and to the receivers and licence-holders concerned for matters before that date.

quote: subsidiary legislation made under the repealed Act or any other written law relating to telecommunication matters and in force immediately before 1 December 1999
gloss: Section 98(2) continues in force, until revoked, subsidiary legislation made under the repealed Act and in force just before 1 December 1999, so far as it is not inconsistent with the Act; it names no instrument, so the link to this Order is by description.

quote: continues in force as if made under this Act until it is revoked or repealed by subsidiary legislation made under this Act
gloss: Section 98(2) continues in force, until revoked, subsidiary legislation made under the repealed Act and in force just before 1 December 1999, so far as it is not inconsistent with the Act; it names no instrument, so the link to these regulations is by description.

quote: This Act does not apply to the licensing of any broadcasting service or any broadcasting apparatus under the Broadcasting Act 1994
gloss: Section 95 takes the licensing of broadcasting apparatus under the Broadcasting Act out of the Telecommunications Act as a whole, which includes this section, except for two matters it lists.

quote: This Act does not apply to the licensing of any broadcasting service or any broadcasting apparatus under the Broadcasting Act 1994
gloss: Section 95 takes the licensing of broadcasting apparatus under the Broadcasting Act out of the Telecommunications Act as a whole, which includes this section, except for two matters it lists.

quote: This Act does not apply to the licensing of any broadcasting service or any broadcasting apparatus under the Broadcasting Act 1994
gloss: Section 95 takes the licensing of broadcasting apparatus under the Broadcasting Act out of the Telecommunications Act as a whole, which includes this section, except for two matters it lists.

quote: All persons shall be exempted from section 30 (1) to (5) of the Act
gloss: The Order exempts all persons from section 30(1) to (5) of the Telecommunication Authority of Singapore Act for equipment approved for sale under the Dealers Regulations, or listed in their Fifth Schedule and meeting the published standards.

quote: means any apparatus capable of or designed or constructed for the reception of any broadcasting service and specified in the First Schedule
gloss: The Broadcasting Act definition of broadcasting apparatus depends on the list in the First Schedule.

quote: telecommunication equipment that is set out in the Fifth Schedule to the Telecommunication (Dealers) Regulations
gloss: The second limb of the Order covers equipment set out in the Fifth Schedule to the Dealers Regulations (Rg 7), so that list decides what it covers.

quote: means a licence granted under section 20 in respect of broadcasting apparatus
gloss: The definition of a broadcasting apparatus licence in section 2(1) points to licences granted under section 20.

quote: contravenes section 20(1)(a), (b) or (c)
gloss: Section 47 refers to section 20(1)(a), (b) and (c) by number.

quote: a contravention of section 20 (1) of the Act
gloss: Regulation 7 of Rg 1, headed Prosecution, refers to section 20(1) of the Act.

quote: means any licence granted under section 20 of the Act in respect of any broadcasting apparatus
gloss: The amending regulations define licence in Rg 1 as any licence granted under section 20 of the Act in respect of any broadcasting apparatus.

quote: every licence granted under section 20(1) of the Act, in respect of any broadcast television receiver
gloss: The revocation regulations refer to licences granted under section 20(1) of the Act when saying which licences the revoked regulations continue to apply to.

quote: the licensing of any broadcasting service or any broadcasting apparatus under the Broadcasting Act 1994
gloss: Section 95 refers to the licensing of broadcasting apparatus under the Broadcasting Act without a section number; the Broadcasting Act section headed Licensing of broadcasting apparatus is section 20.

quote: have the meanings given by the Broadcasting Act 1994
gloss: The Telecommunications Act gives broadcasting apparatus and broadcasting service the meanings given by the Broadcasting Act, whose definitions are in section 2(1).

quote: approved for sale by the Authority under regulation 24 (1) of the Telecommunication (Dealers) Regulations (Rg 7)
gloss: The first limb of the Order covers equipment approved for sale under regulation 24(1) of the Dealers Regulations (Rg 7).

quote: cancelled or suspended in accordance with section 21, read with section 12, of the Act
gloss: Regulation 4(2) of the TVRO regulations refers to section 21, read with section 12, of the Act; section 21 applies sections 10, 12 and 16 to broadcasting apparatus licences.

quote: in respect of which a ship station licence has not been granted under the Telecommunications Act (Cap. 323)
gloss: Regulation 23(1) of Rg 1 mentions vessels in respect of which a ship station licence has not been granted under the Telecommunications Act.

quote: in a vessel in respect of which a ship station licence has not been granted under the Telecommunications Act (Cap. 323)
gloss: Regulation 28(2) of Rg 1 mentions vessels in respect of which a ship station licence has not been granted under the Telecommunications Act.

quote: Regulation 2 of the Singapore Broadcasting Authority (TVRO System) Regulations (Rg 3) (referred to in these Regulations as the principal Regulations) is amended
gloss: Changes definitions in regulation 2 of the TVRO regulations and replaces their regulations 3, 4, 5, 8 and 9, at a time when they were titled the Singapore Broadcasting Authority (TVRO System) Regulations.

quote: Sections 10, 12 and 16 apply, with the necessary modifications, to broadcasting apparatus licences
gloss: Section 21 applies sections 10, 12 and 16, with the necessary modifications, to broadcasting apparatus licences, which section 2(1) defines as licences granted under section 20.

quote: In exercise of the powers conferred by section 73 of the Telecommunications Act
gloss: Notification N 1 says it is made under section 73 of the Telecommunications Act, which is section 96 of the 2020 Revised Edition and lets the Minister exempt any person or class of persons from all or any of the provisions of the Act.

quote: Sections 33, 34 (1) (b) and 35 of the Act shall not apply to any person in respect of
gloss: Notification N 1 says sections 33, 34(1)(b) and 35 of the Act shall not apply to any person in respect of the stations it describes and the equipment in its Schedule; section 34(1)(b) of the 2000 Revised Edition is section 54(1)(b) of the 2020 Revised Edition.

quote: Sections 33, 34 (1) (b) and 35 of the Act shall not apply to any person in respect of
gloss: Notification N 1 says sections 33, 34(1)(b) and 35 of the Act shall not apply to any person in respect of the stations it describes and the equipment in its Schedule; section 35 of the 2000 Revised Edition is section 55 of the 2020 Revised Edition.

quote: In exerc ise of the powers c onferred by sec tion 96 of the Telec ommunic ations Ac t 1999
gloss: The 2023 amending notification says it is made under section 96 of the Telecommunications Act 1999.

quote: the principal Notification), in paragraph 1, replace “sections 33, 34(1)(b) and 35” with “sections 53, 54(1)(b) and 55”
gloss: Replaces sections 33, 34(1)(b) and 35 with sections 53, 54(1)(b) and 55 in paragraph 1 of N 1 and, by paragraph 3(a), in its paragraph 2, with effect deemed to be 31 December 2021 although first published on 28 August 2023.

quote: In the principal Notification, in the First Schedule
gloss: Changes the First Schedule of N 1, including by replacing items 8 to 15; the replacement item 11, headed Remote Control Devices, again lists sub-item (e) TV Receivers/ Radio Systems.

quote: Regulation 5 of the principal Regulations is amended
gloss: Replaces paragraphs (2) and (3) of regulation 5 of Rg 1 with a new paragraph (2) on how long a licence is valid, and replaces its paragraphs (6) and (8), which set additional fees for varying a licence.

quote: Regulation 6 of the principal Regulations is amended by deleting the words
gloss: Deletes the words 'for a broadcast sound receiver or a broadcast television receiver' from regulation 6 of Rg 1.

quote: Regulation 8 of the principal Regulations is amended by deleting the words
gloss: Deletes the words 'for any broadcast sound receiver or any broadcast television receiver' from regulation 8 of Rg 1.

quote: Regulations 16 to 22 of the principal Regulations are deleted and the following regulation substituted therefor
gloss: Deletes regulations 16 to 22 of Rg 1 and substitutes a new regulation 16 on applications for a licence to import, offer for sale, sell or otherwise deal in any broadcasting apparatus.

quote: Regulation 31 of the principal Regulations is amended
gloss: Deletes the words 'and for every extension from that broadcast television receiver' from regulation 31(1)(a) of Rg 1 and changes a cross-reference in regulation 31(2).

quote: Regulation 33 of the principal Regulations is deleted and the following regulation substituted therefor
gloss: Replaces regulation 33 of Rg 1 with a regulation headed Restricted monochrome licence, about a licence to install or operate a broadcast television receiver in monochrome.

quote: The heading to Part VI of the principal Regulations is deleted and the following heading substituted therefor
gloss: Replaces the heading to Part VI of Rg 1 with the heading Block licence for broadcast television receivers.

quote: Regulation 36 of the principal Regulations is deleted and the following regulation substituted therefor
gloss: Replaces regulation 36 of Rg 1 with a regulation headed Block licence, under which the Authority may permit the owner of a hotel or hospital, or the owner or occupier of a commercial property, to apply for a block licence for the broadcast television receivers installed or operated there.

quote: The Second Schedule to the principal Regulations is deleted and the following Schedule substituted therefor
gloss: Replaces the Second Schedule of Rg 1 with a table of late payment fees for the grant or renewal of a broadcast sound receiver licence, a broadcast television receiver licence, a block licence and a licence to deal in broadcasting apparatus.

quote: The Schedule to the Telecommunications (Exemption from sections 33, 34 (1) (b) and 35) Notification 2001 is deleted and the following Schedule substituted therefor
gloss: Deletes the words 'in-building or' from paragraph 2(b) of N 1 and deletes N 1's Schedule, substituting a new Schedule whose item 11, headed Remote Control Devices, lists sub-item (e) TV Receivers/ Radio Systems.

quote: The Schedule to the Telecommunications (Exemption from sections 33, 34 (1) (b) and 35) Notification (N 1) is amended
gloss: Amends the Schedule of N 1 in several places, including by deleting item 11, Remote Control Devices, and substituting a new item 11 that again lists sub-item (e) TV Receivers/ Radio Systems.

quote: The Schedule to the Telecommunications (Exemption from sections 33, 34(1)(b) and 35) Notification is deleted and the following Schedules substituted therefor
gloss: Amends paragraph 2 of N 1 and deletes N 1's Schedule, substituting a First Schedule and a Second Schedule; item 11 of the First Schedule, headed Remote Control Devices, lists sub-item (e) TV Receivers/ Radio Systems.

quote: The Fifth Schedule to the principal Regulations is amended
gloss: Amends the Fifth Schedule of the Dealers Regulations 2003 (Rg 6), including by inserting after item 2 an item for integrated receiver decoder devices intended for use with second generation digital terrestrial television broadcasting system; the item names no specification.
